Subject: Dalmora Roofing - Submission Decline

Hi Marcus,

Thank you for thinking of us for Dalmora Roofing. I've reviewed the submission and unfortunately we'll need to pass on this opportunity.

Our current appetite excludes roofing contractors, so we're not able to provide a competitive quote for this risk. I know this isn't the answer you were hoping for, but I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty contractor market that focuses on roofing operations—they'll be better positioned to offer appropriate coverage and pricing for Dalmora.

I appreciate you sending this our way, and please keep us in mind for other risks that might be a better fit.

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
